## Context
Owner (Denis) answered a batch of open owner-taste beads on 2026-10-22; the answers are in comments "Owner decided 2026-10-22" on each bead. Rule-changing answers:
- Sleep length is set by an energy bar that fills; she wakes when full; forced sleep with high energy wakes after a short PLACEHOLDER time; very long sleep only for later special states (lifesim-ar3h, lifesim-d5f.6).
- Memory sensitivity is a random draw within a range per person (lifesim-5ban.15, memory.R22).
- The warning countdown setting folds into the existing difficulty dots setting (lifesim-log).
- Tests drive input through Unity's native test input (Input System test devices), no game-code hook (lifesim-d5f.28).
- First versions of costly 1.0 items: crises = fire + starvation collapse only; one illness; pets = one kind, walk and sit only; ageing = elder look only (lifesim-66x).
- Must-have objects for the shareable build: table, chairs, sink, plates, second bed (lifesim-yxbb.7).
- Log and crash file live next to the saves, never uploaded (lifesim-yxbb.8).
- macOS only for now: Windows factory onboarding parked (epic lifesim-gfr.30).
- Godot work parked except lifesim-yxd6 and lifesim-ivgk.

## Done when
- design/decisions/2026-10-22-*.md records exist, one per rule-changing answer above (or grouped where tightly related), each with the owner's words, the rule and the beads it touches.

- just check is green.

## Out of scope
Implementing any of the rules (their own beads do that); the non-rule answers (closed, parked or auto-labelled beads); the Godot and Windows beads beyond a one-line decision record.

• Matching requirements in design/systems/*.md edited to the new rules.
